data.one_liner: A ListView with load more and pull‑to‑refresh support
data.what_it_does: Provides a ListView that automatically shows a load‑more widget when more data is available and supports pull‑to‑refresh. It offers builder, separated, and custom scroll view constructors.
use_when: You need infinite scrolling with a simple load‑more button
You want pull‑to‑refresh without writing boilerplate
You prefer a single widget that handles pagination logic
avoid_when: You require fine‑grained control over pagination logic
You need advanced state management or custom animations
You are building a highly customized list that needs more features
strengths: Easy to integrate with minimal code
Handles short lists and refresh edge cases
weaknesses: No built‑in state management or caching
No support for complex data sources
data.minimal_example:
LoadMoreListView.builder(
  haveMoreItem: true,
  onLoadMore: () async{ await Future.delayed(const Duration(seconds:1)); },
  onRefresh: () async{ await Future.delayed(const Duration(seconds:1)); },
  itemCount: 20,
  itemBuilder: (context, index){ return Text('$index'); },
);
